description: Search published releases on Bitsound by text (title, artist, track titles, lyrics), genre (matches the main or the second genre), mood of at least one track, release type, price range in EUR and AI labelling. Returns releases with price, AI label and the release URL. Use get_release for the track list.

ai.description: AI labelling to include: no (made without AI), partly, yes (AI generated), unspecified. Example: ["no"] for human made music only

genre.description: Genre, one of: Electronic, House, Techno, Trance, Ambient, Downtempo, Synthwave, Pop, Rock, Indie, Jazz, Classical, Hip-Hop, Soundtrack, Experimental, RnB, Metal, Folk, Blues, Country, Reggae, Latin, World, DrumAndBass, Dubstep, Schlager, Kids, SpokenWord, Other. Matches the main or the second genre of a release

maxPriceEur.description: Maximum price of the whole release in EUR

minPriceEur.description: Minimum price of the whole release in EUR

mood.description: Mood, one of: calm, relaxed, energetic, danceable, dark, happy, melancholic, aggressive. Matches releases with at least one track of this mood (detected from the audio or set by the artist)

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging

query.description: Free text: release or track title, artist name, words from the lyrics

sort.description: Order: new (newest first, default), title (A-Z) or price (cheapest first)

type.description: Release type: album, ep or single

name: catalog_search
title: Search the Bitsound catalog
